source.label: Placed in M100 as the app draws it, where the star's sight line crosses the disc's midplane: 15,215,772 pc (src/objects/m100-layers/source/recipe.json: centre 15,210,000 pc, inclination 38.5 deg, line of nodes 156.2 deg). The galaxy's distance, which places the galaxy and not a star within it: Leroy et al. (2021), PHANGS-ALMA, ApJS 257, 43, table of galaxies, row NGC4321: distance 15.21 ± 0.5 Mpc, from the compilation of Anand et al. (2021) (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/ApJS/257/43)

controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Color of a blackbody at the star's temperature; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The color of a blackbody at the star's published temperature. The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,720 K and log g 0.65 (u1 0.706, u2 0.076): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention.
